description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for gathering and managing system information such as network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes methods for registration, notification, device ID retrieval, and data updates.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management within the PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Class managing internet connectivity details such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Class managing security-related information such as callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Class providing location details including timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Class representing device identification details such as identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification client from receiving system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the raw MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively notifies all registered clients of updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::Set
methods.description: Sets the internet information based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Security::Set
methods.description: Sets the security information based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Location::Set
methods.description: Sets location information based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree.
